knownGaps: Current Lido deployed-contract pages do not document testnet deployments for Arbitrum, Optimism, or BSC.
Contract source repositories and commits were not present in the selected documentation sections and remain uncollected.
Audit reports were not present in the selected documentation sections and remain uncollected.

Proxy-to-implementation links are inferred from adjacent rows with matching documented labels; CrossChainController admin links are explicitly described by the documentation.

deploymentEntryFields.deploymentId: Stable identifier for one deployed address on one concrete network. For EVM deployments in this draft, it is the CAIP-10-shaped combination of networkId and address.
deploymentEntryFields.contractId: Source-independent identifier for the protocol role fulfilled by the deployment. A proxy and its implementation share the same contractId when they jointly fulfill the same protocol role.
deploymentEntryFields.contractName: Contract label used by the Lido deployed-contracts documentation. It is not guaranteed to be the exact compiler artifact name.
deploymentEntryFields.contractNameStatus: Qualification describing how contractName was established. documented-label-not-artifact-verified means the name came from Lido Docs but was not checked against compiler metadata.
deploymentEntryFields.integration: Lido multichain integration to which the deployment belongs, such as arbitrum, optimism, or bsc.
deploymentEntryFields.deploymentKind: Structural kind of the deployed address: contract, proxy, implementation, proxy-admin, or library.
deploymentEntryFields.documentationStatus: Status expressed by the source documentation. documented means listed without an additional proposal marker; proposed and proposed-to-remove preserve explicit markers from Lido Docs.
deploymentEntryFields.address: Network-native address of the deployed contract instance. EVM addresses preserve the spelling and checksum casing published by Lido Docs.
deploymentEntryFields.networkId: Globally scoped concrete-network identifier. EVM networks use the CAIP-2 eip155 namespace, for example eip155:1.
deploymentEntryFields.networkName: Human-readable canonical name for the concrete network on which the address is deployed.
deploymentEntryFields.chainFamily: Broader blockchain or rollup family to which the concrete network belongs, such as ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, or bnb-smart-chain.
deploymentEntryFields.environment: Operational classification of the concrete network, such as mainnet or testnet. This is distinct from the network's identity.
deploymentEntryFields.explorerUrl: Block-explorer page for the deployed address, copied from the source documentation.
deploymentEntryFields.documentationUrl: Lido Docs section from which the deployment address and label were collected.
deploymentEntryFields.source: Contract source-code provenance object when collected; null means no contract source repository was established for this draft entry.
deploymentEntryFields.sourceStatus: Collection state for source. not-collected means the draft makes no claim that source-code provenance is absent.
deploymentEntryFields.auditReports: Audit reports associated with the deployment or its code scope. An empty array must be interpreted together with auditReportsStatus.
deploymentEntryFields.auditReportsStatus: Collection state for auditReports. not-collected means the empty array is not a claim that no audits exist.
deploymentEntryFields.proxy: Proxy relationship metadata. Present only when deploymentKind is proxy and a related deployment was recoverable from the documentation.

proxyFields.proxyKind: Proxy architecture, such as transparent, uups, beacon, diamond, custom, or unknown. unknown means it was not established from the selected documentation.
proxyFields.implementationDeploymentId: deploymentId of the separately listed implementation address currently associated with the proxy in this draft.
proxyFields.adminDeploymentId: deploymentId of the separately listed proxy-admin address when the documentation explicitly identifies it.
